name: lobotomy
description: One brain per task: route the main loop, plan mode, subagents, review, commits, compaction and quick questions to the model you choose. /lobotomy opens the config pane.

discover.title: Discover gateway models
discover.description: At session start, list the models the session's gateway serves (GET /v1/models at ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) and offer new ones through /lobotomy setup

presets.title: Catalog presets
presets.description: name=id entries seeded into the catalog on first use, each only when the gateway lists that id: name=id; name=id
